items.title: Classification with Abstention Under Class-Conditional Error Constraints
items.title_zh: 类别条件误差约束下的带弃权分类
items.summary: The paper studies binary classification with abstention under separate class-conditional error constraints, aiming to minimize abstention while keeping both errors below prescribed thresholds. It characterizes the distribution-free minimax rate of excess abstention risk, introduces surrogate-loss formulations with finite-sample guarantees, and analyzes computational complexity in the convex setting.

items.title: Evaluating the NIST Bugs Framework Against CWE as a Successor for Automated Vulnerability Classification
items.title_zh: 评估 NIST Bugs Framework 作为自动化漏洞分类继任框架相对 CWE 的表现
items.summary: The paper evaluates NIST's Bugs Framework as a classification target and complement to CWE using CVE data, an inter-rater study with two subject-matter experts, and two LLM deployments. The findings support Bugs Framework as more structured and automation-friendly than CWE, while identifying gaps such as under-specified guidance on attributes.

items.title: Rapid Loss of the Sierra Nevada's Largest Trees Driven by Fire
items.title_zh: 火灾驱动内华达山脉大型树木快速丧失
items.summary: Using a U-Net-ID model on 2020 sub-meter aerial imagery, the study maps 6,515,705 large trees across the Sierra Nevada Floristic Province and tracks their health with Sentinel-2 time series and BFAST breakpoint detection. Wildfires were the dominant driver of large-tree mortality, killing 10% of all large trees, concentrated in the 2020–2021 fire seasons.

items.title: Layerwise Decoupling for Stable Structured Sparsification of Fully Connected Layers
items.title_zh: 全连接层稳定结构化稀疏化的逐层解耦方法
items.summary: The paper proposes a decoupled, layerwise method that extracts shallow two-layer subnetworks, normalizes inner weights, and applies a structured group penalty to each outer weight matrix to prune neurons and reduce layer width. It proves equivalence to a joint penalty at optimality and reports a wider usable regularization range and less catastrophic over-pruning than a joint baseline.

items.title: Proximal Residual Value Functions for Consistent Planning and Real-Time Execution
items.title_zh: 面向一致性规划与实时执行的近端残差价值函数
items.summary: The paper proposes an end-to-end reinforcement learning method that learns continuation-value functions for two-timescale decision systems by combining a strictly convex potential of post-decision inventory with a learned convex residual, yielding a differentiable yet convex optimization layer for real-time execution. In an offline simulation using historical inventory and demand data from a large e-commerce retailer, it reduced total routing and transfer cost by 5.0% relative to a historical-production-system proxy.

items.title: XYEval: Agents say yes to bad advice
items.title_zh: XYEval：智能体对糟糕建议说“是”
items.summary: The paper introduces XYEval, a meta-evaluation framework that transforms existing benchmarks into XY-problem tests of whether agents resist plausible but misleading user suggestions and explain their reasoning, evaluated across five models and six benchmark suites. It reports relative performance drops of up to 46.7% under XY mutation, shows performance falls further with a pedantic user, and finds that a simple system-instruction baseline offers only partial mitigation.

items.title: SoK: Formal Methods for Fact-Checking and Information Integrity
items.title_zh: SoK：面向事实核查与信息完整性的形式化方法
items.summary: This systematization of knowledge organizes 121 works on automated fact-checking by what is formalized rather than by pipeline stage, yielding five levels: the claim, the reasoning, the checking system, the information ecosystem, and the regulatory obligation. It finds that most relevant formal machinery already exists but was built for other domains, that the gap is widest for verifying the checking system itself, and that writing a claim in checkable form and correcting a published verdict lack stated correctness criteria.
